function updateSpaceLoader(c, msg, pct): void

Defined in: experiments/earth-playground/space/boot.ts:28

Mirrors an engine progress event into the loader overlay — message, rounded percent text, and the bar's width style. All three nodes are optional-chained so a partial loader render can't throw mid-boot.
